d: Shri hanuman chalisa evan bhajan sangrah | shani dev bhajan | vishnu dhun | aarti sangrah prastut hai shri hanuman ji, bhagvan vishnu aur shani dev ko samarpit bhaktimay bhajnon ka sundar sangraha. is divy bhajan sangrah men hanuman chalisa, jagdish aarti, shani dev ke bhajan, narayan dhun aur aartiyan hain | kuchh sthanon par aaj shanivar ke din bhi ekadshi rahegi, at aaj shanivar ke din shri hanuman chalisa se aarambh karte hue bhagvan vishnu ki aarti, dhun ke sath hanuman ji ki aarti, shanidev bhajan evan aarti ka aanand len
